name: Ecwid (*.company.site storefronts)
notes: Wizard flow mapped in the 2026-06 campaign; no receipt-verified purchase yet.

steps.contact: Email, plus a REQUIRED Terms checkbox that gates the Continue button.
steps.billing: Wizard: name/address after email; advance with 'Continue to Payment'.
steps.payment: Select the card payment method, then a Stripe frame. Card-number token, then the CVV token into the payment/CVC frame immediately after.

gotchas: The Terms checkbox must be ticked before Continue enables — target only terms/agree checkboxes, never arbitrary ones.
